content.value: Devise Ladder programs for a system that will carry out the following task:
Switch on a pump when the water level in a tank rises above 1.2 m and switch it off when it falls below 1.0 m.
ii. Switch on a pump, then 100 s latter ON a heater, then a further 30 s latter switch on the circulating motor.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2023
